answers.core:
I'm not sure how common of a problem it is, but it's gotten me more than once.
If `class_name` didn't automatically add the class to the `Add Child Node` dialog, this would be less of an issue.
If that were the case, an `@in_editor` annotation could be added before `class_name` to make it appear under `Add Child Node`.

Related: https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/1047

title: Show popup message when selecting custom class with `Add Child Node`
